spanish: Y vinieron todos los sabios, los haciendo toda obra del santo, varón por varón de su obra que ellos hacían.

findings.issue: הַקֹּדֶשׁ is a definite common noun (holiness / sacred thing). "del santo" resolves it as a masculine person (the saint / the holy one).
The definite qal participle הָעֹשִׂים (“the ones doing”) is rendered by the ungrammatical “los haciendo”; the doing is present but not a clear relative clause.
מִן marks source (“from his work”). “de su obra” reads as a genitive and weakens that preposition.

notes: Wayyiqtol, both כָּל, the wise, את, distributive אִישׁ־אִישׁ, אֲשֶׁר, הֵמָּה, and the second qal participle otherwise stay within the tokens.
